_comment: Retired, and kept read-only. Nothing in this repo publishes any more: the café is the Cloudflare link (CLAUDE.md, "Where the café lives"), and a change reaches it by a merge to main. These three pages and their databases are still there, and two of them are still worth reading: the café's for the licensed art it holds (CLAUDE.md, "The licensed art") and for her four project maps, which live nowhere else; the quiz pages for answers filed before the queen's quest log replaced them (litterbox/README.md). Never publish to any of them. Someone setting up a café of their own publishes their own artifact and records its URL in their own copy of this file (catio-plugin/skills/catio/SKILL.md) -- never over one of these.
